title: A single hold (Fenmarch) alone consumed ~100 turns once side-quests and companion content were engaged, and the game's own guidance ('40-70 turns per hold, 15 holds, 300-turn ceiling') makes the advertised 'big' ending (3 hollows rested + Vale king + first Reeve's confession, or reaching Marrowgate) effectively unreachable in one sitting for a thorough player, even one moving with clear intent rather than wandering.
